events.output: RECONSTRUCTED from conversation record after a session interruption, not verbatim. Option A (YAML route with uri: no://op and filter SetStatus=404): the context loads (contextLoads passes) but does not return 404. The handler still attempts an HTTP proxy call and fails with 'Unroutable protocol scheme: no://op', giving HTTP 500. The WebFlux gateway idiom does not carry over to spring-cloud-gateway-server-webmvc (Spring Cloud 2025.1.1 / Boot 4.0.5). Option B (plain @RestController in the gateway mapped to /purchase/retry-config): failed a live check. The existing /purchase/** -> lb://order-service gateway route wins over annotated controllers. Live requests of all methods and path variants still hit the orderService route (503 'Unable to find instance for order-service', no Eureka running) and never reached the controller. Separately, DispatcherServlet answers OPTIONS itself (200 + Allow), so a controller-based 404 cannot cover OPTIONS (MockMvc test expected 404, got 200). Untried: a highest-precedence servlet Filter, or a predicate on the orderService route that excludes the path.
